scripts.all: bun run gen && bun run build
scripts.gen: node compiler/tools/gen_compiler.js --assemble all && node compiler/tools/gen_compiler.js compiler/templates/x86_64.json > out/gen/jit-dispatch-x86-64.wat && node compiler/tools/gen_compiler.js compiler/templates/aarch64.json > out/gen/jit-dispatch-aarch64.wat && node compiler/tools/gen_compiler.js compiler/templates/arm32.json > out/gen/jit-dispatch-arm32.wat
scripts.build:full: bun run gen && bun run build:ui && bun run pipeline-stages && bun tools/build_wat.mjs
